prompt: B2B onboarding: baseline 41%, MDE +5pp, 95%/80%, 25k total users but 15% eligible

assertions.name: sample_size_per_group_calculated
assertions.description: Sample size per group should be approximately 1,537 users

assertions.name: total_sample_size_calculated
assertions.description: Total sample size should be approximately 3,074 users (1,537 × 2)

assertions.name: estimated_duration_weeks
assertions.description: Estimated duration should be approximately 3.6 weeks based on 3,750 eligible users per month

assertions.name: formula_used
assertions.description: Conversion metric formula must be used: (z_α/2 + z_β)² × (p1×(1−p1) + p2×(1−p2)) / (p2 − p1)²

assertions.name: correct_eligible_traffic_interpretation
assertions.description: Must use only eligible traffic (3,750 new sign-ups per month), not total user base

assertions.name: double_multiplication_avoided
assertions.description: Must NOT multiply final result by 2 as the formula already accounts for both groups
assertions.expected_value: only multiply once at the end for total (n_per_group × 2)
